ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in East Africa changed by +0.285 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.225 to +0.347), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.704 °C.

ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in East Africa shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.09): the estimate is −0.038 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.082 to +0.006). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
